Since then I've sat on 100% cash, as no opportunity has appealed to me. In the same period, the SMALLCAP index is down over 18%, while I have gone flat.

1886274243459260921.text: The willingness to exercise sit-out power is key. I will continue to do so, until the odds appear to be sufficiently in my favour again to risk my money. Mark Minervini has summed this up beautifully in his below tweet.

1881555826672079069.text: Lot of stocks that are acting strong in my watchlist just ran up off their lows into new highs, w/o much of a right side development. I look for tight, low-risk entry points. Until I see that, I'm not interested no matter how much these stocks run up.

1880614611071959324.text: Importance of reentry — amateurs get scared of stocks that stop them out once or twice, PROs look at every trade setup as a new opportunity. RKFORGE (one of the mkt leaders of 2023 bull run) a reminder of that. Went up 150% in 5 months from a new base after multiple failed BOs.
